sourceRows.zh: adj.成功的 结果良好的 圆满的

ex.en: Among those over 45 who'd successfully switched careers, 74% said training helped them get their new job.
Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.

senses.zh: advS.成功地

tip: 画面联想：复用「success」的相关场景；请以本词释义为准。

sourceRows.zh: advS.成功地

ex.en: Should you look at the same word in rapid succession, or look at the word and then have some delay before you look at it again?

senses.zh: n.连续 继任 继位 继承 继承权

tip: 画面联想：复用「successor」的相关场景；请以本词释义为准。

sourceRows.zh: n.连续 继任 继位 继承 继承权

senses.zh: adj.连续的 接连的 接二连三的

ex.en: The US was founded by successive ways of immigrants, and immigrants are still contributing to America today.
He was the first horse to take successive firsts since Reynoldstown in 1935-1936.

tip: successive指接连的；successful才是成功的。

sourceRows.zh: adj.连续的 接连的 接二连三的

senses.zh: adj.这样的 如此的 pron.这样的人或事 adv.如此地

ex.en: Most people set goals to achieve delayed, long-term benefits, such as career advancement, debt repayment, or improved health.
The teens chose healthy snacks and drinks (such as fruit or water) more often over unhealthy options (like biscuits and soda).

tip: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。

sourceRows.zh: adj.这样的 如此的 pron.这样的人或事 adv.如此地

senses.zh: vt.吸 吮 啜 吸收 吸入 vi.吸 吸收 奉承 <俚>烂 令人讨厌 n.吸吮 吸力

ex.en: Nowadays forests are increasingly welcome because they suck in carbon pollution from the air.
A litre of bottled water can cost well over a pound, especially for something fancy that has been sucked through a mountain.

col: suck through a straw｜用吸管吸
tip: 表示“很糟糕”时属非正式用语，不宜用于学术写作。

sourceRows.zh: vt.吸 吮 啜 吸收 吸入 vi.吸 吸收 奉承 <俚>烂 令人讨厌 n.吸吮 吸力

senses.zh: adj.突然的 意外的 快速的 出乎意料的 n.突发之事

ex.en: Sudden increases in blood sugar cause the release of insulin(胰岛素) to bring it back down to a stable level.
What about making a sudden turn to avoid a dog?

tip: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

sourceRows.zh: adj.突然的 意外的 快速的 出乎意料的 n.突发之事

senses.zh: adv.突然地

ex.en: Through no fault of their own, they can suddenly find their productivity deteriorating or quality control non-existent.
Seen through the lens of the present self versus the future self, our self-defeating actions—like choosing to watch television rather than go to the gym—suddenly make perfect sense.

tip: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

sourceRows.zh: adv.突然地

senses.zh: vt.遭受 忍受 容许 允vi.受苦 患病 受损失

ex.en: People who systematically underestimate themselves and their own performance suffer from the so-called Impostor Phenomenon.
The disadvantage, obviously, is that local farmers will suffer under this situation.

tip: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

sourceRows.zh: vt.遭受 忍受 容许 允vi.受苦 患病 受损失

senses.zh: adj.足够的 充分的

ex.en: After some adjustments, and sufficient time, Jill was able to answer the students' questions correctly 97% of the time.
"This argument is, at best, far from sufficient," he writes.

tip: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

sourceRows.zh: adj.足够的 充分的

senses.zh: adv.足够地 充分地

ex.en: Reward all those involved in the debate sufficiently when the goals are reached.
A gamification strategy that is not sufficiently thought through or well tailored to its players may engage people for a little while, but it will not motivate people in the long term.

tip: 修饰形容词时放在其前；enough则放在其后。

sourceRows.zh: adv.足够地 充分地

senses.zh: n.糖 vt.使甜 使具有吸引力 vi.形成糖状 变成颗粒状 造枫糖浆

ex.en: Fish, chicken and red wine make moderate appearances, while red meat, salt and sugar are used much less often.
Juices containing vegetables can provide more nutrients and less sugar than juices made up of just fruit—but they still lack valuable fibre.

tip: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

sourceRows.zh: n.糖 vt.使甜 使具有吸引力 vi.形成糖状 变成颗粒状 造枫糖浆

senses.zh: vt.建议 暗示 启发 要求

ex.en: Instead, they suggest it may be more of a lifelong process—a continuous, never-ending exercise that requires self-awareness and timely adjustments.
The findings suggest that some people may be too emotionally clever for their own good, says Bechtoldt.

col: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

sourceRows.zh: vt.建议 暗示 启发 要求

senses.zh: n.建议 意见 暗示 迹象 联想

ex.en: Record's suggestion is to prohibit agents from hiring models with a BMI below 18.
But part of Game Academy's suggestion is to transform casual gamers into "conscious" ones, applying critical thinking to developing their skills.

tip: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

sourceRows.zh: n.建议 意见 暗示 迹象 联想

senses.zh: n.起拆 诉讼 请求 套装 vt.适合 取悦 满足

ex.en: "In face-to-face interviews, they're not as noticeable, because there are other things like your hair, suit, or body language to distract people."
While a good suit works wonders for our performance in the boardroom, wearing formal wear isn't a great idea when we want to socialize.

col: suit your needs｜满足你的需求
tip: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。

sourceRows.zh: n.起拆 诉讼 请求 套装 vt.适合 取悦 满足

senses.zh: adj.合适的 适宜的 adv.<古>合适地 恰当地

ex.en: What type do you think would be suitable for a barbecue?
The International Civil Aviation Organization, which works to define the principles of air travel, suggests that countries use a suitable type, size and style for official documents like passports.

col: a suitable candidate｜合适的候选人
tip: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。

sourceRows.zh: adj.合适的 适宜的 adv.<古>合适地 恰当地

senses.zh: n.硫(磺) 硫黄

ex.en: The guide showed us yellow sulphur near the volcano.
ex.zh: 导游给我们看了火山附近黄色的硫磺。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Burning fuels containing sulphur releases gases that contribute to acid rain and damage natural ecosystems.
ex.zh: 燃烧含硫燃料会释放促成酸雨的气体，破坏自然生态系统。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

sourceRows.zh: n.硫(磺) 硫黄

senses.zh: n.总数 金额 顶点 概略 一笔钱 vi.共计 总计 概括

ex.en: In these twin studies, identical and non-identical twins are asked, for example, to split a sum of money with a peer.
"Why can't we put in our résumé our gaming victories and achievements?"

col: a large sum of money｜一大笔钱
tip: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

sourceRows.zh: n.总数 金额 顶点 概略 一笔钱 vi.共计 总计 概括

senses.zh: vt.概括 概述 总结 摘要而言

ex.en: Could you summarize the story before we discuss it?
ex.zh: 我们讨论之前，你能概括一下这个故事吗？

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Students should learn to summarize research findings accurately rather than reproduce every detail from their sources.
ex.zh: 学生应学会准确概括研究结果，而不是复述资料中的每个细节。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

col: summarize the findings｜概括研究结果
summarize the main points｜总结要点
tip: 英式也常拼作summarise；总结时保留要点。

sourceRows.zh: vt.概括 概述 总结 摘要而言

senses.zh: n.摘要 概要 一览 adj.概要的 简略的

ex.en: Could you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
ex.zh: 你能简要说说这次会议的内容吗？

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
ex.zh: 报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: a summary of后接概括对象；in summary用于总结。

sourceRows.zh: n.摘要 概要 一览 adj.概要的 简略的

senses.zh: n.夏 夏季 adj.夏季的 v.度过夏天

ex.en: Organisers of a famous music festival announced that water bottles will not be sold this summer.
The average American student receives 13 weeks off from school each calendar year-with about 11 of those during the summer.

tip: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

sourceRows.zh: n.夏 夏季 adj.夏季的 v.度过夏天
